regulations.name: IEC 60950-1:2005 including AMD1:2009 and AMD2:2013
regulations.context: Insulation coordination for MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION

regulations.name: IEC 62368-1:2018
regulations.context: Insulation coordination for MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION

tests.name: Ball-pressure test on insulating material
tests.description: Parts of insulating material supporting uninsulated parts of MAINS PART subjected to ball-pressure test at 125°C ±2°C or ambient indicated in technical description ±2°C plus temperature rise from 11.1 test

tests.name: Exclusion from ball-pressure test
tests.description: Test not performed on parts of ceramic material, insulating parts of commutators, brush-caps, and similar, and on coil formers not used as REINFORCED INSULATION

tests.name: Resistance to environmental stress
tests.description: Insulating characteristics and mechanical strength of all MEANS OF PROTECTION not likely to be impaired by environmental stresses including deposition of dirt resulting from wear of parts within EQUIPMENT, potentially reducing CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES below 8.9

tests.name: Ceramic and similar materials restriction
tests.description: Ceramic and similar materials not tightly sintered, and beads alone not used as SUPPLEMENTARY or REINFORCED INSULATION

tests.name: Insulating material with embedded heating conductors
tests.description: Insulating material with embedded heating conductors considered as one MEANS OF PROTECTION but not two MEANS OF PROTECTION

tests.name: Natural latex rubber aging test
tests.description: Parts of natural latex rubber aged by suspending samples freely in an oxygen cylinder containing commercial oxygen to a pressure of 2.1 MPa ±70 kPa, with an effective capacity of at least 10 times volume of samples

tests.name: Natural latex rubber crack inspection
tests.description: No cracks visible to naked eyes after samples kept in cylinder at 70°C ±2°C for 96h, and afterwards left at room temperature for at least 16h

tests.name: CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES overall
CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES per Tables 12-16
tests.description: CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES are to values in Tables 12 to 16 (inclusive), except as specified in Clauses 8.9.1.2 to 8.9.1.15. Insulation between parts of opposite polarity of the MAINS PART on the supply mains side of any mains fuse or OVER-CURRENT RELEASE, one MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION are to values in Table 13, Table 14 and Table 16.

tests.name: Exemption for IEC 60950-1 / IEC 62368-1 compliant MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION
tests.description: Values of Table 12 to Table 16 do not apply to CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES forming MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION that comply with IEC 60950-1:2005/AMD1:2009/AMD2:2013 or IEC 62368-1:2018 for INSULATION CO-ORDINATION. Equipment/sub-assemblies/components complying with IEC 62368-1:2018 designed specifically for use with transient-free supply mains shall additionally comply with Table 13 to Table 16.

tests.name: Minimum CLEARANCE as minimum CREEPAGE for inorganic materials
tests.description: Specified min CLEARANCE applied as min CREEPAGE for CREEPAGE DISTANCES across glass, mica, ceramic and other inorganic insulating materials with similar tracking characteristics

tests.name: Minimum CLEARANCE applied as minimum CREEPAGE when smaller
tests.description: When min CREEPAGE derived from Tables 12 to 16 was less than min applicable CLEARANCE, value of min CLEARANCE applied as min CREEPAGE DISTANCE

tests.name: Altitude rating - 2000 m standard
tests.description: ME EQUIPMENT RATED to operate at an altitude of 2000 m

tests.name: Altitude rating - manufacturer specified
tests.description: ME EQUIPMENT RATED to operate at an altitude specified by MANUFACTURER

tests.name: Altitude - pressurized environments
tests.description: Operating altitude corresponding to actual air pressure for ME EQUIPMENT intended for pressurized environments (e.g., aircraft) used to determine multiplication factor from Table 8, and AIR CLEARANCE multiplied by this factor. CREEPAGE DISTANCES not subjected to multiplication factors, but were at least as large as the resulting value for AIR CLEARANCE.

tests.name: Interpolation of CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES for intermediate WORKING VOLTAGES
tests.description: CREEPAGE DISTANCES determined by linear interpolation between the nearest two values in Tables 12 to 16, and the calculated spacing rounded off to the next higher 0.1 mm increment

semantic_fragments.content: CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES forming MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION that comply with IEC 60950-1:2005, AMD1:2009 and AMD2:2013 or IEC 62368-1:2018 for INSULATION CO-ORDINATION and are used in the conditions (e.g. overvoltage category, pollution degree) under which compliance was tested are exempt from Table 12-16 values. Exception: Equipment/sub-assemblies/components complying with IEC 62368-1:2018 designed specifically for use with transient-free supply mains shall additionally comply with the applicable requirements of Table 13 to Table 16.

When WORKING VOLTAGE is between values listed in Tables 12 to 16, CREEPAGE DISTANCES shall be determined by linear interpolation between the nearest two values, and the calculated spacing rounded off to the next higher 0.1 mm increment. See Insulation Diagram for actual values.

All MEANS OF PROTECTION insulating characteristics and mechanical strength shall not be impaired by environmental stresses, including deposition of dirt resulting from wear of parts within EQUIPMENT that could potentially reduce CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES below values specified in 8.9.
